prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A family of three generations enjoys a relaxed New Year dinner: grandparents aged 68 and 73, parents aged 35 and 39, and an 8-year-old child sit close together around a modest table. They share food and conversation while the child smiles at a grandparent. Use warm home lighting, an understated tree, and candid group framing. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: a silver-haired grandmother with a short bob and glasses, a slim white-haired grandfather with a short white beard, a mother with dark curly hair, a fair-haired clean-shaven father, and a child with short chestnut hair. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. Use a WIDE environmental establishing shot with generous room around the group. All main people, whole faces, heads and important hands must fit inside the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of the image width; leave the left and right edges for ordinary room context.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: This MUST be a distant FULL-ROOM establishing photograph from 7 metres away, natural 24mm perspective, not a close group portrait. The complete family and the whole dinner table occupy only the MIDDLE HALF of image WIDTH (horizontal coordinates 25%-75%), with empty room context in the LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER. Their heads and all important hands are in the middle 45% of image width. Show ceiling, floor, windows, furnishings and more of the room around them. Small full seated figures, not foreground large heads. Preserve native 16:9.
review: Replacement is a distant full-room New Year dinner with all five family members and table inside the central half. Faces, visible hands, cups and seated limbs are coherent. Generous room margins protect the central square/card crop; no text. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
